analyticalMisses.summary: Milwaukee was the clearest same-game concentration miss: MIL ML -$10 and MIL 4+ -$25, combined -$35.

analyticalWins.summary: Profit came from multiple market families (team totals, moneylines, pitcher Ks, F5) instead of one concentrated thesis -- the most diversified profitable day of the six reconciled.

Bennett 5+, McLean 6+, Drohan 5+ (3-0) suggest selecting a strikeout ladder near the modal expected outcome may be preferable to stretching for high plus-money rungs. Do not overgeneralize from 3-0 -- family not yet proven.
F3 Tie lost, but its modest stake and plus-money structure were preferable to paying heavy protected-F5 juice merely for tie insurance -- a process point independent of the loss.

blockedWagers.detail: 3-market combo (raw Initial Cost $9.99, rounded risk $10, paid $0, max payout $40.20; legs: PHI 4+ W, BAL 4+ L, MIA 4+ W). Duplicates straight PHI 4+ and BAL 4+ exposure; moderately correlated with MIA F5 via MIA 4+. No canonical representation for a multi-leg combo exists; excluded from canonicalTotals. Accounts for the $10 gap between the user-reported full-slate P/L (+$78.41 across 22 positions) and the canonical straight-only P/L (+$88.41 across 21 positions).

earlyClosePositions.detail: TB vs BAL F5, NO on Baltimore wins F5 (economic exposure while held: TB leads or ties after five). Risk $22, closed-position paid out $19.16, realized P/L -$2.84. Represented via executionStatus=SOLD_EARLY / exitSaleProceeds=19.16 (lib.edgelab.bets schema) rather than a binary settlement -- the held-to-settlement counterfactual is deliberately never inferred.
